title.narrative: Support to fight organised crime, enhance Taiwan¿s crisis preparedness, mineral sustainability with Australia, and strategic communication in West Africa

description.narrative: This action will enable the EU to address short and medium-term foreign policy needs and opportunities by supporting innovative policies and initiatives, and by deepening EU relations and dialogues with target communities, forging alliances and partnerships. In particular, this action will promote responses to organised crime and drugs trafficking that are evidence-based, balanced, humane, and in line with human rights and the rule of law in key regions of the world; deepen the EU-Taiwan relationship and enhance disaster management and civil protection capacities in Taiwan; contribute to a stable, diversified, and sustainable supply chain of critical raw materials for the EU through advancing the roadmap for the implementation of the EU-Australia strategic partnership of critical raw material (CRM); improve the positioning of the EU in West African countries, by improving the knowledge and capacity of local key interlocutors, media, and youth leaders; strengthening relations and networks with the EU; and fostering a more balanced, independent and fact-based information and communication.
